# Plan: demo (v1)

## Overview

Deterministic mock plan for "demo". Implements a small module using TDD.

## Steps

1. Write a failing test for the core function.
2. Implement the function until the test passes.
3. Refactor for clarity.

## Code Snippets

```js
// src/feature.mjs
export function feature(input) {
  if (input == null) throw new Error('input required');
  return String(input).trim();
}
```

```js
// test/feature.test.mjs
import { feature } from '../src/feature.mjs';
import assert from 'node:assert';
assert.equal(feature('  hi '), 'hi');
```
